questions.question: How is the name of the LORD described in Proverbs 18?
options: A deep well from which all of the wise draw their very life
A heavy yoke that the weak can scarcely bear
A strong tower; the righteous run into it and are safe
A walled city that bars the gates to sinners
questions.answer: A strong tower; the righteous run into it and are safe
